UnitCount.description: Count of units to be ordered, e.g. 10 in case of 10 beers.

UnitAmount.title: Amount parameters
UnitAmount.description: Unit amount, e.g. amount for one beer (note that total amount of the item is therefore `UnitAmount` times `UnitCount`).

AccountingCategoryId.description: Unique identifier of an `AccountingCategory` to be assigned to the item.

ExternalIdentifier.description: External identifier of the order item.
